title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
abstract: arXiv:2611.24039v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-s

translated_title: 面向受监管企业的智能体AI平台评估能力框架
translated_abstract: 智能体AI平台——即LLM智能体在其中进行规划、调用工具、保留记忆并协同操作以改变企业系统状态的系统——其采购速度已超过对其进行评估衡量的速度。公开的智能体基准测试是在固定测试环境中对模型进行评分；而企业购买的是集成平台，其编排、记忆、治理和工具层对最终结果起主导作用，且企业购买这些平台在很大程度上依据的是供应商的演示。我们报告了一项由某全球性银行创新实验室开展的工业界评估项目（“竞赛评测”），其中十个平台——涵盖开源框架、专有产品和超大规模云厂商生态系统——由跨职能评审小组在三个金融服务工作负载（交易对手信用风险、检索增强生成和流程自动化）上，按九个能力维度进行评估。评分结果将该领域划分为三个层级，这些层级在替代权重方案下保持稳定，并揭示了工作负载（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一套用于评估受监管企业中智能体AI平台的能力框架，通过对全球银行三个金融服务工作负载上十个平台的九维度评测，将市场划分为在权重变化下依然稳定的三个层级。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a capability framework for evaluating agentic AI platforms in regulated enterprises, where a global bank's cross-functional panel assessed ten platforms across nine capability dimensions on three financial-services workloads, revealing three stable performance tiers.
